capabilities: Publish a folder as a hosted wiki or digital garden
Configure site chrome, theme and domain in a sidebar
Publish as a guest without signing in
Claim a site to a signed-in account
disambiguation: Not a local garden or graph viewer; it uploads a folder to a hosted website.
extras: Guest publishing is capped at 100 MB with 7-day rolling content retention; signed-in sites are permanent with 200 MB. Single-note public links are handled by a separate product, MDFriday Share. Much of the README is developer and identity metadata.
problem: Putting a wiki or digital garden online normally means signing up for an account, setting up Git and configuring a static site.
summary: Publishes a vault folder as a hosted wiki or digital garden from a right-click menu, without an account or Git.
